payload.title: Freeze E001 validation substrate
payload.decision: Promote E001 and freeze folds/v1.json through folds/v5.json, the data signature, metric definitions, and control semantics.
payload.rationale: The 773-well full run reproduced the registered baseline, passed all controls, and produced byte-identical artifacts across three committed-code runs.
payload.revisit_trigger: Only a demonstrated evaluator defect with a separately recorded migration decision.
